title: State fixes in release notes
body:
Use proper release notes on the App Store, even if you don't say exactly what was fixed.

When you get a bug report and fix it, extend some courtesy to the customer who reported it instead of pretending it never existed. At least say thank you instead of a workaround (obvious statements like "look elsewhere for info", etc.).

Btw, I want to say some of us are proud of this business. It is the only one of its kind that works (a digital bank built from the ground up, not a wrapper over a traditional bank), and that too in the UAE.

It has been getting slower over the past few months. Watch out for speed and reliability (NFRs), or you will end up with as much friction as traditional banks, or worse.

Find ways to be transparent about credit eligibility, or link out to other apps or partner with other agencies for credit score/usage.

On Wio Invest, disclose data leaks more prominently and more promptly, like the recent DriveWealth one. Consider IBKR or similar for folks who want to place orders directly.

This is some feedback from someone who has been in this industry for many years, close to two decades.

title: The best banking service so far
body:
I really love the Wio app and the features it offers. For me, it has become an all-in-one platform for banking, managing, saving, and growing my money. The overall experience has been great so far, and I appreciate how the platform continues to improve.

A few features I would love to see added in the future:

* Dark mode/light mode option for better accessibility and personalization.
* Transaction notes: When making a transaction, there should be an option to add personal notes or labels to track where money is spent and manage finances more effectively.
* ATM cash deposits: If not already available, adding the ability to deposit cash through ATMs would make managing money much more convenient.
* More country support: Some countries are currently not supported, and expanding availability would make Wio more useful for international users.
* Direct wallet transfers: Support for more direct wallet-to-wallet transfers would improve convenience.
* Metal card upgrade option: It would be great to have an option to upgrade to a premium metal card that’s also customizable for an additional small fee across all plans.

Other than these suggestions, Wio has been a great banking experience for me so far. I really like the direction the platform is heading and look forward to seeing more features added in the future.

Banks in the region can provide significant value to their clients by making these specific instruments available on their platforms.
As a high net worth individual I value the Wio investment platform however it needs to help us use our UAE resident status more effectively.

title: They ban VPNs
body:
I used Wio as my main bank for a year and then they decided to ban VPNs. 

A lot of people in the UAE use VPNs because the excessive internet censorship in the country.

It’s annoying that they ask us to disable VPN and claim that it’s to protect our account. It’s such obvious nonsense. 

To add insult to injury, after they show you the VPN error message, you have to manually kill the app, log in again, and then dismiss all the first-time-user pop ups. It’s such a horrible experience. 

Wio is the only bank I know that blocks VPNs. 

I used to use Wio daily. But ever since they made it so cumbersome to check our account status, I’ve been switching over much of my banking to a competitor. Eventually I’ll close my Wio account.

title: Extremely Disappointing Experience – Account Frozen Without Explanation
body:
I had been using Wio Bank for almost a year with absolutely no issues and genuinely enjoyed how simple and convenient the app was. Unfortunately, all of that changed about a month ago when my account was suddenly frozen without any explanation.

Since then, I’ve called customer support five separate times, and every single time I receive the same vague response: “Sorry, we are investigating.” No one can tell me why my account is frozen, what triggered it, or when it will be resolved. I can’t use my card, I can’t send money, and I’m left completely in the dark.

The only time I received any written response from them was after filing a complaint with the Central Bank. Even then, their reply was just another generic “we are working on it.” At least the Central Bank informed me that I should expect a response within 30 business days, which is apparently the timeframe Wio has been given to fix the issue — but it’s extremely frustrating that the bank itself provided no clarity at all.

For a digital bank that promotes convenience and transparency, this experience has been the complete opposite. Having your money locked with no explanation and no timeline is incredibly stressful. I can no longer recommend Wio Bank based on what I’ve gone through.

title: WIO Investing Is Not Ready for Public Use – Serious Limitations That Put Customers at Risk
body:
Review:
I have been an active trader for several years—day trading, swing trading, and long-term investing across multiple global platforms. I recently decided to try WIO’s new “WIO Investing” product, and the experience has been extremely concerning from both a risk-management and operational standpoint.

After purchasing nearly $300,000 worth of shares through WIO, I attempted to sell the position during a time-sensitive market move. Only then did I discover—without any prior notice—that WIO limits customers to selling a maximum of 50,000 shares per transaction (and effectively per day).

There was no warning before buying, no mention of this limitation during order placement, and no disclosure in the app that selling is restricted in this manner. Anyone with trading experience understands that liquidity and exit flexibility are non-negotiable in any investment platform. Allowing customers to buy large positions freely while restricting their ability to exit those positions is both illogical and potentially dangerous.

I contacted WIO’s support immediately and escalated the matter to their investment team. Despite acknowledging the urgency of the issue, no one followed up for two weeks. When I contacted them again, a manager simply stated that this limitation was “company policy,” without offering any explanation for why the platform allows unlimited buying but severely restricted selling.

This raises a critical question:
What happens if a customer invests hundreds of thousands—or millions—and the stock drops sharply?
Under WIO’s current restrictions, users would be unable to liquidate quickly, potentially incurring massive losses through no fault of their own other than relying on WIO’s platform.

From my experience, WIO appears to be launching products too quickly without the necessary infrastructure, safeguards, customer support, or basic trading features that every other established brokerage provides (Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Fidelity, etc.).
No reputable brokerage limits your ability to sell your own positions in this way.

WIO’s customer service has also been consistently slow, unresponsive, and difficult to escalate, which only compounds the risk of using their investment product.

I previously recommended WIO to others, but after this experience, I cannot continue to do so.
WIO Investing is not ready for public use and poses real financial risk due to poorly designed policies, a lack of transparency, and inadequate customer support.

Until these issues are addressed, I strongly advise traders and investors to avoid using WIO Investing. The platform needs significant improvements before it can responsibly support users’ financial decisions.

title: Good for Simple Investing, But Not Ready for Active Trading
body:
The app has a nice design and is easy to use for basic investing and banking services. However, there are two issues that make it difficult for more active investors:

• Delayed Pricing: The displayed prices often lag behind the actual market, which creates uncertainty when buying or selling.

• Missing Trailing Stops: There’s no way to set trailing stops or advanced orders to protect profits automatically.

I understand Wio is mainly a banking platform and not a full-featured trading app, but adding these basic tools would help a lot of users manage risk more confidently. I hope future updates will address this.

Customer support then said they listened back to my phone call and there was a ‘glitch’.

No email or phone has been received since the day I raised the issue - even though I was promised I would get the problem personally looked into

My suggestion is:

title: Easy and simple to use
body:
Love the app, enough so for me to leave a review. Super easy to use, and looks great!

A few suggestions I have:
- Change the order of the 2 currencies that are being exchanged as it feels counterintuitive. In my opinion (and having seen it like this in other apps) it would make sense for the currency at the top to be the currency you want to swap from and the one below should be what you want to swap to
- Would be helpful if you can search for other Wio users by a username or phone number.
- Would be great if you can customise app notifications
- Refer a friend feature
- Be able to deposit money using Apple Pay

Thank you for making banking in the UAE easier!

title: Lukewarm customer experience
body:
I applied for Wio Personal over a month ago and since then, my application has been stuck in a sort of limbo, listed as "Under Review" with no further updates or feedback from the team. This has been particularly frustrating for me, as I have been a loyal user of Wio Business for my company for over six months.

I had higher expectations for Wio, given my previous experience with their business service. However, the lack of communication and the seemingly endless wait for application approval have made this an incredibly disappointing experience. It's disheartening to see that Wio Personal doesn't seem to maintain the same standard of customer service and efficiency that I have come to expect from their business offering.

Would I recommend Wio Personal based on this experience? Unfortunately, no. I hope the team takes note and works on improving their application and review process for future customers.
author: Kunstlerischerleiter

reply.body:
We would like to begin by expressing our sincere apologies for the disappointing experience you've encountered during your application process for Wio Personal. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we genuinely appreciate you taking the time to share your concerns.
